items.name: erwerbssteuer
items.label: Income tax (Erwerbssteuer), Art. 19 SteG single tariff (1% to 8% above CHF 15,855), with a 180% communal surcharge, the highest: up to 22.4%

notes: The communal surcharge is 150% to 180% depending on the commune; the estimate uses 180%, so in a 150% commune the income tax is about 11% lower. Wealth (taxed through a 4% notional return) and joint taxation of couples are not included.
VAT rates are the Swiss ones: Liechtenstein must adopt Swiss VAT changes under its VAT treaty with Switzerland.
The reserve estimate uses the single tariff of Art. 19 SteG (version of 1 July 2026) and a 180% communal surcharge, the highest of the 11 communes (they range from 150% to 180%).
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
